title: Crown and Fruki Bebidas raise over R$120,000 for Pink October with donated pink cans
summary: For the second consecutive year, Crown and Fruki Bebidas have created a distinctive edition of Água da Pedra for Pink October and the POA Ladies Run, a women's race promoted by the brand in Porto Alegre, using the beverage can as a highly visible platform to support breast cancer awareness. The initiative builds on more than two decades of partnership between Crown and Fruki Bebidas and brings together hydration, active lifestyles and support for an important cause.
body_markdown:
For the second consecutive year, Crown and[Fruki Bebidas](https://fruki.com.br/) have created a distinctive edition of Água da Pedra for Pink October and the[POA Ladies Run](https://www.poaladiesrun.com.br/) , a women's race promoted by the brand in Porto Alegre, using the beverage can as a highly visible platform to support breast cancer awareness.


The initiative builds on more than two decades of partnership between Crown and Fruki Bebidas and brings together hydration, active lifestyles and support for an important cause.


Held in Porto Alegre on October 18, the 3rd edition of the POA Ladies Run, a women-only race promoted by Água da Pedra and organised by Run Sports, brought together more than 3,000 women across 3,5 and 10 km routes, a 50% increase in registrations compared to last year. The event supports the national Outubro Rosa (Pink October) campaign, promoting breast cancer awareness, prevention, and early detection. This year, the campaign theme was "Move. Every movement matters.", encouraging women to move on every front, from getting screened and practicing sport to rallying in support of people affected by cancer.


At the heart of this year's activation was a recyclable, limited-edition pink can of Água da Pedra. For the 2026 campaign, Crown and Fruki Bebidas once again used the aluminum substrate to give Pink October a distinctive physical presence. Crown supported the initiative by producing the limited-edition cans at no charge, enabling Fruki Bebidas to direct additional support to[Instituto Camaleão](https://www.institutocamaleao.org/) , an organization that has offered free support to breast cancer patients, their families and caregivers sinoce 2014, and was also present at the event. In total, the 2026 campaign raised more than R$120,000 for the institute, doubling the amount donated in 2025. Around 75% of this amount came from the can initiative with Crown, with the remainder coming from part of the race registration fees. The funds will allow Instituto Camaleão to double its number of support groups, expand its psychological support and launch individual care.


A partnership making an impact


For more than 20 years, Crown and Fruki Bebidas have worked together on beverage packaging, combining Fruki's strong connection with consumers in Southern Brazil with Crown's expertise in[beverage cans](https://www.crowncork.com/beverage-packaging/products/beverage-cans) and[decoration](https://www.crowncork.com/beverage-packaging/decorations) .


Strongly rooted in Rio Grande do Sul, Água da Pedra is one of the region's most recognized mineral water brands, with an identity built around natural hydration, wellbeing and active lifestyles, naturally echoing the POA Ladies Run.


Aline Eggers Bagatini, CEO of Fruki Bebidas, said: "This year, Água da Pedra celebrates 25 years as a brand, and Pink October campaigns have been part of its story for almost half of that journey. That makes this year's can even more special: beyond being commemorative, it carries a reminder of care and prevention. This year's campaign, with record fundraising, reinforces the brand's commitment to promoting women's health and wellbeing."


Image


More than a package


With its vivid pink design and running-inspired graphics, the limited-edition 350ml sleek can puts the campaign directly into consumers' hands. And its impact extends beyond the race. For the first time, the special Água da Pedra edition was also sold at points of sale across the market (the 2025 edition circulated exclusively at brand events), allowing the Pink October message to move from Crown’s production lines to the race and into everyday consumption occasions.


Image


For beverage brands, this highlights one of the can's particular strengths: the package itself can become part of the message. Its large printable surface offers extensive creative possibilities for limited editions, seasonal campaigns, partnerships and promotional activations, helping brands create distinctive designs that stand out at events and at the point of consumption.


The role of cans is already an important part of Água da Pedra's packaging strategy, helping the brand develop its presence in sporting events, out-of-home consumption, premium occasions and marketing activations.


Altair Frulane, Commercial Operations Director at Crown Brazil, said: "A beverage can does much more than contain a product, it carries a brand, a message and, in this case, an important cause directly into consumers' hands. Our long-standing partnership with Fruki Bebidas gives us the opportunity to combine our expertise with a brand that has strong roots in its local community. Seeing the overwhelmingly positive reception of the pink Água da Pedra can at the POA Ladies Run and across the region shows how packaging can help amplify a campaign well beyond a single moment."

Pink October across Crown


The collaboration in Brazil is part of a wider commitment across Crown during Breast Cancer Awareness Month. Across our global network, our teams organized local initiatives focused on awareness, prevention and support. From fundraising for cancer research, patient care to self-check guidance, and activities supporting organizations working with people affected by breast cancer, these actions reflect a shared commitment to supporting the health and wellbeing of our people and local communities, and we are proud of our teams for their continued dedication.
